summary: A fictional D2C snack brand, used to show a full client file. Founder-led talking-head and tasting reels in Hinglish: loud five-style caption cycle with a slight tilt, product names on the printed pack spelling, one warm orange accent, punchy SFX on the bite, a bright acoustic bed.

brand.name_spelling: 'Crunchwell' is one word, capital C only (never CrunchWell or Crunch Well). Product names on overlays use the PRINTED pack spelling exactly, e.g. 'MASALA PEANUT CRISP'.

language.designed_copy: English. Owned tagline reused verbatim: 'Loud crunch. Clean label.'
language.spoken_captions: Verbatim in the language spoken (Hinglish romanized, never translated); captions follow what is SAID even when it differs from the pack name.
language.notes: Numbers on screen (protein, calories) must be checked against the actual pack; never invent nutrition figures.

logo.notes: Master mark is orange on transparent; a cream recolour (same alpha) is used on orange cards. Add the client's real files to `files` (path relative to the repo or absolute) before rendering.

caption.notes: Body face of the caption cycle.

caption_display.notes: Big reaction hits ('FIRST BITE') at 96-132 px and product-name label line 1 (72 px). Anton caps are ~0.73 of the point size: place from measured ink.

caption_tag.notes: Small non-spoken aside below the chin.

type_scale.notes: Caption 78 px; label line 1 = 78 x 1.414^0 rounded to the Anton cap height; hero hits = 78 x 1.414 (110 px).

captions.policy: House policy PLUS: on tasting reels captions run THROUGHOUT the speech, so a product-name LABEL never suppresses captions; it stacks 95 px above the caption, or takes the top band while captions drop to the elbow line. No caption over the hero packshot.

9:16.notes: Chosen PER CAPTION from what else is on screen: top band free -> above the head (fixed y for the cut); a product-name label on screen -> elbow line (fixed ink bottom, re-measured per take, never below y1520); above-head graphics -> fixed bottom band, one style, no tilt.

captions.keyword_rule: One keyword per card: the number if there is one, else the product or flavour word.
captions.notes: The five-style cycle is for plain talking-head and tasting reels. When a brief asks for small or clean captions, use `clean` at 52 px, no tilt.

motion.product_name_notes: A product name on screen holds at least 5 s so it can be read and remembered.
motion.hook: Cold open only when a reveal is withheld (e.g. the first bite reaction).

audio.bed_notes: Bright acoustic or light percussion bed; nothing dark or minor-key on a tasting reel.

sfx.signature: One crunch SFX on the first bite, synced to the measured action frame.

sacred_rules: Pack art and the logo are never altered, recoloured, cropped or redrawn.
Product names are spelled exactly as printed on the pack.
Never claim a health benefit that is not printed on the pack.

formats.five-style-caption-cycle: outline -> chip -> plate_orange -> plate_cream -> plate_ink, tilt alternating 1.5-3.0 deg, one keyword per card.
formats.product-name-label: Anton line 1 (72 px) + Poppins line 2 (34 px), stacked 95 px above the caption, held >= 5 s.

open_questions: Logo master files (orange and cream) have not been supplied yet.
Static brand type is a geometric sans; should video captions also move off Poppins to match?
